identity.label: identity and direction

identity.soft: A description of yourself can feel useful when it fits what you actually return to. A familiar project or an interest you can name plainly can offer a scene for that fit.

structure.label: structure and commitments
structure.hard: This window lands on the structural part of your chart — contracts, obligations, long arrangements. Pressure here is usually about something carrying more weight than it was built for.
structure.soft: This window lands on the structural part of your chart, so it tends to favour tidying arrangements: what you formalise now generally holds.
structure.prompt: Which commitment would you renew on purpose, rather than by default?

Steady persistence pairs naturally with targeted action. Focusing on a durable priority makes it easier to direct effort toward concrete, incremental steps without wasting momentum.
Active initiative finds firmer footing when backed by consistent habits. Putting energy into a defined routine or clear responsibility helps immediate progress hold its ground over time.
